items.title: Engineering GenAI with MLflow
items.summary: Slides from the kickoff session of the Vadodara Databricks User Group (November 28, 2026).You changed the prompt. Is your GenAI app better now? Can you ship it? This session answers that question with one small app that analyzes customer reviews, and takes it from prototype to production on Databricks Free Edition: versioning the prompt with the Prompt Registry, tracing each request, comparing two prompt versions with LLM judges and reading the results, releasing by moving an alias, deploying with Databricks Apps, and monitoring quality in production.Notebook: https://github.com/taka-yayoi/engineering-genai-with-mlflowQuestions: https://usergroups.databricks.com/v0/forum/engineering-genai-with-mlflow-331/topic/engineering-genai-with-mlflow-vadodara-dug-nov-28-2026-questions-and-follow-up-903/インド Vadodara の Databricks User Group キックオフでの登壇資料です。プロンプトを変えたとき、アプリが良くなったのかをどう確かめるかを軸に、MLflow のプロンプトレジストリ、トレース、評価、Databricks Apps へのデプロイ、本番モニタリングまでを Free Edition で一通り説明しています。
